summary: ansible.builtin.apt examples: install, remove and pin package versions (name: foo=1.00), install lists with pkg, update_cache, default_release, allow_downgrade, fail_on_autoremove, install_recommends: no, upgrade all with name '*' state latest, and upgrade: dist.
questions: How do I install a specific package version with apt in Ansible?
How do I run apt-get dist-upgrade with Ansible?
How do I update all packages with the apt module?
How do I install without recommends using apt?

answer_card.title: Common apt module tasks
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.apt:
    name: foo=1.00          # specific version
- ansible.builtin.apt:
    name: nginx=1.18.0
    allow_downgrade: yes
- ansible.builtin.apt:
    name: "*"
    state: latest           # upgrade all packages
- ansible.builtin.apt:
    upgrade: dist           # apt-get dist-upgrade
- ansible.builtin.apt:
    name: openjdk-6-jdk
    install_recommends: no
```
